_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wee Mchezaji {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Lengo lako ni kushinda zaidi ya matatu mfululizo (kwa mlalo, wima, au ulalo) kwenye bodi.
Kwenye mchezo wako, unapaswa kuchagua nambari ya mraba (0-8) unataka kuweka alama yako inayofuata.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' inaweka alama yako katikati ya seli ya bodi.
Kama Mchezaji {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kusuntha kumene kwaperekedwa sikukutsatira mtundu wolondola.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selo yoyenera. Ayenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 8.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} anaweka alama yake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
